result.instructions: Tools for Ringover, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our calls from last week were longer than 10 minutes, and who took them?"; "Give me the AI summary of the call with the Acme lead from yesterday."; "Add Maria Lopez from Acme as a contact with her mobile number.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Ringover data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run ringover_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run ringover_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run ringover_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. ringover_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: ringover_list_calls
tools.title: List calls
tools.description: List terminated calls with direction, numbers, duration and status. Needs Calls Read. The date window spans at most 15 days (default: last 15 days). Ringover: GET /calls.

end_date.description: Window end (inclusive). Max 15 days after start_date.

last_id_returned.description: Cursor: last call id from the previous page.

tools.name: ringover_get_call
tools.title: Get a call
tools.description: Get one call by id: parties, times, duration, recording and tags. Needs Calls Read. Ringover: GET /calls/{callId}.

tools.name: ringover_list_transcriptions
tools.title: List transcriptions
tools.description: List call transcriptions with optional text search and date or duration filters. Needs the team's transcription feature (plan setting), not a key permission. Ringover: GET /transcriptions.

created_from.description: Created on or after this date-time.

created_to.description: Created on or before this date-time.

tools.name: ringover_get_transcription
tools.title: Get a transcription
tools.description: Get the transcript of one call by call id. Needs the team's transcription feature. Ringover: GET /transcriptions/{callId}.

call_id.description: Call id, from ringover_list_calls or ringover_list_transcriptions.

tools.name: ringover_get_empower_call
tools.title: Get an Empower call
tools.description: Get one call's Empower analysis record by call UUID. Needs Empower Read; visibility depends on the Empower role. Ringover: GET /empower/call/{callUUID}.

tools.name: ringover_get_call_summary
tools.title: Get an AI call summary
tools.description: Get the AI-generated summary and recap of one call. Needs Empower Read. The text is AI output, not a transcript. Ringover: GET /empower/call/{callUUID}/summary.

tools.name: ringover_get_call_moments
tools.title: Get key moments of a call
tools.description: List the key moments Empower detected in one call. Needs Empower Read. Ringover: GET /empower/call/{callUUID}/moments.

annotations.title: Get key moments of a call

tools.name: ringover_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the team's users with their ids, names and emails. Needs Users Read. Ringover: GET /users.

tools.name: ringover_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get one user by id, with extension and settings. Needs Users Read. Ringover: GET /users/{userId}.

tools.name: ringover_list_teams
tools.title: List team information
tools.description: Get the team's information (name and settings). No specific key permission needed. Ringover: GET /teams.

tools.name: ringover_list_numbers
tools.title: List phone numbers
tools.description: List the team's phone numbers. Needs Numbers Read. The is_* filters narrow the result; user and IVR numbers need Monitoring ON. Ringover: GET /numbers.

is_available.description: Only numbers that are free to assign.

tools.name: ringover_list_ivrs
tools.title: List IVRs
tools.description: List the team's IVRs (phone menus). Needs IVRs Read. Ringover: GET /ivrs.

tools.name: ringover_list_tags
tools.title: List call tags
tools.description: List all call tags of the team. Needs IVRs Read; Monitoring is not needed. Ringover: GET /tags.

tools.name: ringover_list_presences
tools.title: List team presences
tools.description: List the presence (available, busy, offline) of every team user. Needs Monitoring ON on the key; without it Ringover returns 401. Ringover: GET /presences.

tools.name: ringover_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List the contacts in the address book, with an optional text search. Needs Contacts Read. Ringover: GET /contacts.

search.description: Text to match in name, company or number.

tools.name: ringover_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: Get one contact with its phone numbers. Needs Contacts Read. Ringover: GET /contacts/{contactId}.

tools.name: ringover_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Create one contact with its phone numbers in the address book. Needs Contacts Write. This writes to the team's address book. Ringover: POST /contacts.

is_shared.description: Share the contact with the team.

tools.name: ringover_list_conversations
tools.title: List SMS conversations
tools.description: List SMS and chat conversations. Needs Conversations Read. Without Monitoring you see only your own. Ringover: GET /conversations.

tools.name: ringover_list_conversation_messages
tools.title: List conversation messages
tools.description: List the messages of one SMS or chat conversation. Needs Conversations Read. Ringover: GET /conversations/{convId}/messages.

last_id_returned.description: Cursor: last message id from the previous page.

tools.name: ringover_list_campaigns
tools.title: List call campaigns
tools.description: List the outbound call campaigns. A valid key is enough (no permission category). Ringover: GET /campaigns/call.

is_running.description: Only campaigns that are running (true) or stopped (false).

tools.name: ringover_get_campaign_logs
tools.title: Get campaign logs
tools.description: Get the audit log of one call campaign by its UUID. A valid key is enough. Ringover: GET /campaigns/call/{campaignscalllistuuid}/logs.

tools.name: ringover_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List the webhook subscriptions of this API key. A valid key is enough. Ringover: GET /webhooks.

prompts.description: Search the contacts for the name first, then create a contact with its phone numbers in the team address book.
